meta.description: A native iOS shopping app for a fashion and footwear retailer in the Arab world, combining classic browsing with a swipe-to-like product feed that sends favourites straight to the bag.

caseStudy.title: Swipe XYZ
caseStudy.lead: A native iOS shopping app for a fashion and footwear retailer in the Arab world, combining classic browsing with a swipe-to-like product feed that sends favourites straight to the bag.

facts.label: Client
facts.value: A fashion and footwear retailer in the Arab world

brief.title: The brief
text: The retailer wanted shopping to feel playful: next to categories and filters, a swipe view where liking a product puts it in the bag.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the native iOS app in Swift and UIKit from the Figma designs.
Implemented sign-in and registration, categories, filters and product pages.
Built the swipe product view that sends liked items to the bag.
Implemented orders and bills, the profile and settings.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: A shopping app with both a classic catalogue and a swipe feed for quick discovery.
